name: hcportal_setPlatformAdmin
description: Mint, change or de-mint a platform admin (E12.F7.S1): upsert on HC.PlatformAdmin.UserId; NULL capability = keep (0 for a new or revived row); @removed = 1 de-mints. Refuses: caller de-minting themselves or dropping their own CanManagePermissions; leaving nobody with CanManagePermissions; a disabled target. Logged to LOG.GeneralLog with before/after flags. Requires HC.PlatformAdmin.CanManagePermissions. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; the target row is locked WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) for the upsert.

parameters.name: targetHasherId
parameters.description: The person (HC.Hasher.id); must be a live account (Removed = 0). NULL returns 'A hasher is required'.

parameters.name: removed
parameters.description: 1 de-mints; anything else is treated as 0 (default).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always one row. Success = 0 on auth failure, missing CanManagePermissions, NULL target, disabled/unknown target, self de-mint or self drop of CanManagePermissions, de-minting someone who is not an admin, leaving nobody with CanManagePermissions (both after ROLLBACK), or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

sideEffects: INSERT or UPDATE HC.PlatformAdmin (upsert on UserId; a removed row is revived with unspecified flags reset to 0)
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.detail: Lines 106-120 write @canViewMonitor … @canManagePermissions as given; a value such as 2 is stored, and readers test = 1, so it silently means 'no'.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
